answer: Each agent bonds stake to an anchor commitment and evaluates the epoch’s identity polynomial to derive a rate-limit nullifier and proof without disclosing its key. Reusing that nullifier for distinct messages in the same epoch exposes Shamir shares; interpolation recovers the private key, proving duplicate use and triggering immediate collateral slashing. This makes the zenith of Sybil resistance enforceable at the wharf: one bonded identity per quota.
